summary: Frontend-only verification of Daily Workplan editor stability fixes. All 8 targeted tests PASSED: (1) typing in wp-employee-0 keeps focus and row stays in place — no jump; (2) typing in wp-manager-1 does NOT trigger auto-sort — row order unchanged; (3) new sort-manager-header-btn in Mgr column header is present, clickable, and correctly groups/sorts rows by manager on click only; (3b) toolbar sort-manager-btn still works; (4) scroll position is stable while typing in a Notes textarea (0px drift); (5) autosave indicator shows 'All changes saved'; (6) cell click selection works (toolbar '1 selected · Set job · Copy · Paste · Clear · Deselect' appears); (7) double-click on a day cell opens the job editor dialog; (8) add-row-btn is visible. All test edits were reverted (Audrius, Chris M mgr, and notes restored to original values). Publish was NOT clicked.
critical_code_review_comments: React console spam: 'Encountered two children with the same key' warning fires repeatedly on WorkplanEditor render (dozens of occurrences per re-render). Likely a non-unique key in a .map() inside the grid — could cause subtle re-render/identity bugs and hurts performance on a 100+ row grid. Investigate keys used on displayRows or the day-column mapping in /app/frontend/src/pages/WorkplanEditor.js.

Multiple '<input type="time"> value does not conform to HH:mm format' warnings for values like '6:30 Am' / '5:30 Am'. The Start column is populating time inputs with human-readable strings ('6:30 Am') that browsers reject silently. Either normalize to 'HH:mm' before binding, or use a text input with masking.
The presence banner 'Warning: Matthew Abrey is also editing this workplan. Changes may conflict.' is styled as a full-width yellow bar with no dismiss control — could be made collapsible.
action_items: Fix duplicate React key warnings in WorkplanEditor.js (non-blocking, but should be resolved for stability/perf).
Normalize time values stored as '6:30 Am' to 'HH:mm' before feeding to <input type="time"> to remove console noise and ensure the picker displays them.
seed_data_creation: None. All edits reverted to original values.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix for row-jump/jolty grid on WorkplanEditor is verified working: no auto-sort on keystroke, focus preserved, scroll preserved (0px drift), manual sort via new sort-manager-header-btn in Mgr column header works and groups by manager. Toolbar sort-manager-btn also works. Autosave, cell selection, double-click job editor dialog, and add-row-btn all functional. Remaining code-quality issues (unrelated to this bug): duplicate React keys warning and invalid time input format warnings — surfaced in critical_code_review_comments.
